title: Run-based plans/reports layout with report runs per plan run (REQ-0095), modeled on _code-security-scanner history/compare
acceptance_criteria: AC2 reports/<exam>/run-<report-run-id>/ with run.json naming the plan run
AC3 many report runs per plan run, no overwrite
AC4 readers accept old and new layouts, nothing moved
AC5 id YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS UTC, INDEX lists report runs with plan run
AC7 follows the scanner model for view/compare history

design.summary: runlayout.py resolver (plan_run_dir/new_plan_run/list_plan_runs/new_report_run/list_report_runs, old+new); id YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS UTC with -N suffix; run.json manifest (plan run, view, registry version, engine commit, status, prev run); readers switched to the resolver; exam run-list and run-compare history views; exam INDEX shows runs table plus file table; legacy folders untouched

implementation.summary: runlayout.py resolver; new plan runs under plans/<exam>/runs/<YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS[-N]>, report runs under reports/<exam>/run-<id> with run.json; last_solved/_already_imported read both layouts; run-list and run-compare; exam runs index; legacy untouched; mock demo: 1 plan run, 4 report runs

unit_test.result: test_runlayout 46 OK; full suite 1747 run (main re-run after the tester's last fix), only the 4 known pre-existing failures

user_notes.note: Q1-Q3 best; model on _code-security-scanner plans/reports history/compare (read-only reference)

next: verifier recount: layout on mock run, legacy untouched, run-list/compare, run.json skip, readers on both layouts
